notes.title: He Who Watches will be releasing in Fall 2025! + Next Fest Demo
notes.content: [p]Hello folks![/p][p]It's been a super busy time working on the game - we've just participated in Thinky Direct where we dropped a Release Month trailer, announcing that the game will be releasing in the Fall! [/p][p]There were a couple of nice articles written about the game from [url="https://www.pcgamer.com/games/puzzle/this-gravity-defying-dungeon-crawler-is-basically-legend-of-grimrock-meets-portal-and-while-the-trailer-had-me-dizzy-the-demo-made-me-feel-like-a-genius/"]PCGamer[/url] and [url="https://www.vice.com/en/article/games-from-the-thinky-direct-i-have-my-eyes-on/"]Vice[/url].[/p][p][/p][h1]Release Month Trailer[/h1][previewyoutube="DyjHyfK-FKo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]Demo[/h1][p]Additionally, we've released a new demo for the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase and the upcoming Next Fest. [/p][p]The demo has been getting a ton of positive feedback, so please check it out if you're interested and drop a review![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Cerebral Puzzle Showcase 2024 - Demo Release!
notes.content:
Hello all - The 2024 edition of [url=https://www.cerebralpuzzleshowcase.com/]Cerebral Puzzle Showcase[/url] starts today and we're in it with a brand new demo! 

This month has been massive for thinky/puzzle game releases, and I'm excited to join the crowd with this demo! If you've played the previous one from last year, this is still worth checking out as the overlap between the two is pretty small. I hope you enjoy!

Thanks again to [url=https://www.draknek.org/]Draknek & Friends[/url] for setting this whole event up!

- Bobby

p.s. We are of course still working towards the full release, hope to have some more news on that front soon.

notes.title: Cerebral Puzzle Showcase & Tiny Teams Festivals!
notes.content:
Hello puzzlers! We are super excited to be a part of both the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CerebralPuzzleShowcase]Cerebral Puzzle Showcase[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/tinyteamsfestival2023]Tiny Teams[/url] festivals this week! There's a new demo ready that is hot off the press.

Please do check out the games in both of these festivals, as there are some amazing thinky games that are also likely made by some tiny teams.

Huge thanks to Yogscast & Astra Games (particularly Joseph Mansfield) for settings up these two events, and for letting He Who Watches be a part of them.

notes.title: Minor Update 0.1.36
notes.content:
0.1.36 Brings some quality-of-life changes, and replaces a particularly frustrating level.


[list]
[*] Added ability to hold the undo button for subsequent presses.
[*] Added a new reset button to instantly reset to the beginning of the level.
[*] Replaced the timer level with a more interesting level near the end of the demo.
[*] Various minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Public Demo Release for Steam's Puzzle Fest!
notes.content:
The demo for He Who Watches is now [b]live[/b]! This demo is an early access sneak peek at what we're working on and includes the first 15 levels of the game. There are 12 main levels and 3 hidden bonus levels.

Things are definitely subject to change, but this demo should provide a great introduction to the game and how it plays. I am so excited to finally get this in to your hands!

If you've got any feedback please don't hesitate to leave it on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1070500/discussions/]Steam Community discussions page[/url]. I hope you enjoy the demo!
